booking.total is the full amount originally charged and INCLUDES the rush fee: total = subtotal - volume_discount - promo_discount + rush_fee + tax, where rush_fee = 25% of (subtotal - volume - promo) when rush, else 0, and tax = 8% of (that net + rush_fee). This matches C-12's reliance on total including the rush fee; the two assumptions are compatible.
Per E-10 total never changes after cancel; separate integer fields cancellation_fee (10% of total, rounded half up) and refund (total minus fee), both 0 while confirmed.
Hours are multiples of 0.5, >= 0.5; availability is a number.
Cancelling twice is a no-op; errors are 4xx, insufficient hours 409.
